questions.q: Wired Ethernet is standardised as IEEE —
questions.solution: **802.3 = Ethernet (wired LAN)**; 802.11 = Wi-Fi; 802.15 = Bluetooth.

questions.q: Hacking (computer-related offences) is punished under which section of the IT Act?
questions.solution: **Sec 66** = computer-related offences — the 'hacking' section with dishonest intent.

questions.q: IP as a protocol operates at the —
questions.solution: **IP = Internet Protocol, Layer 3** — addressing and routing; TCP/UDP sit above it on Layer 4.

questions.q: The keyboard shortcut to insert the current date into a cell (as a fixed value) is:
questions.solution: Ctrl+; stamps today's date; Ctrl+Shift+; stamps the time; Ctrl+D fills down from the cell above; Ctrl+T creates a table.
questions.shortcut: Semicolon = stamp. Shift makes it time instead of date.

questions.q:
Choose the correct order of the parts to make a meaningful sentence.

**1.** Reading books is a habit worth cultivating. **P:** It improves vocabulary and concentration. **Q:** Children who read daily perform better in school. **R:** Unfortunately, television has replaced books in many homes. **S:** Parents should therefore encourage reading from an early age. **6.** A nation of readers must begin at home.
questions.solution: 'It' needs the noun from S1 (reading) → **P** opens. **Q** gives the school evidence. **R** contrasts ('Unfortunately') with the good run. **S** concludes with 'therefore' just before S6. PQRS.
questions.shortcut: Pronoun orphan test opens P; therefore-clause closes the chain.

questions.q: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.  Hard work is the key to ___.
questions.solution: After 'the key to' (here a preposition) we need a noun → **success**. The family: succeed (verb), successful (adjective), successfully (adverb).

questions.q: What does the café owner imply when he says, 'a small screen and a forty-page form do not go together'?
options: Long forms are hard to fill on a phone, so people still need his computer and help
Phones are too expensive for most people in the town
The government should print forms on paper only
Young people do not know how to use phones
questions.solution: He first says 'Most of them have phones' and then 'but…'. So owning a phone is not enough: a long form is difficult on a small screen, which is why they come to him. He says most customers DO have phones, so cost is not the issue; he makes no demand about paper forms; and he blames the screen size, not the users' skill.
questions.shortcut: The clause after 'but' carries the speaker's point.
questions.passage:
The small hill town had one bus a day to the district headquarters. It left at six in the morning and came back at seven in the evening, so anyone who needed to visit a government office lost a full day's wages for a task that might take twenty minutes. When the state began offering its certificates and forms online, the town's only cyber café suddenly had a queue outside it every morning.

The owner, a retired schoolteacher, charges ₹20 for filling a form and printing it. He says his busiest customers are elderly farmers applying for pensions and young people applying for jobs. 'Most of them have phones,' he says, 'but a small screen and a forty-page form do not go together.'

questions.q:
Choose the correct order of the parts to make a meaningful sentence.

**1.** Several of India's glaciers are shrinking fast. **P:** Hence, experts say, cutting emissions is now a matter of survival. **Q:** This loss threatens the rivers that millions depend on for water. **R:** As a result, some glaciers have retreated by over a kilometre. **S:** Rising temperatures melt more ice each summer than winter snow can replace. **6.** Saving the glaciers will need action from every country.
questions.solution: 'Hence' marks **P** as the closer. Before it: the cause **S**, 'As a result' **R**, and 'This loss' **Q**, which sums up the retreat. **SRQP**.
questions.shortcut: Closing signal (Hence) last; cause -> result -> 'This loss' before it.

questions.q: With which neighbouring country does India share its longest international land border?
questions.solution: India's border with **Bangladesh** is about **4,096.7 km** — the longest. China (3,488 km) and Pakistan (3,323 km) follow. The shortest is with Afghanistan (106 km).
questions.shortcut: 'Big Cats Prowl Near My Big Area' — B first.

questions.q: Which region of India receives most of its rainfall from the retreating (north-east) monsoon?
questions.solution: The retreating winds pick up moisture over the **Bay of Bengal** and strike the Tamil Nadu (Coromandel) coast from the north-east, giving **October-December** rain - the main rainfall of that region.

questions.q: The **White Revolution** (Operation Flood) made India self-sufficient in —
questions.solution: **Milk** — Operation Flood, led by **Verghese Kurien** (Amul). Blue = fish, Yellow = oilseeds, Green = food grain.

questions.q: Earth is **nearest** to the Sun (perihelion) on:
questions.solution: **Perihelion falls on 3 January** (about 147 million km); aphelion, the farthest point (152 million km), comes on 4 July - so the north's winter happens near the nearest point.

questions.q: Simplify: $\frac{0.1 \times 0.1 \times 0.1 + 0.02 \times 0.02 \times 0.02}{0.2 \times 0.2 \times 0.2 + 0.04 \times 0.04 \times 0.04}$
questions.shortcut: Every denominator number is exactly double the numerator one (0.2 = 2 × 0.1, 0.04 = 2 × 0.02), so denominator $= 2^3 \times$ numerator ⇒ answer $= \frac{1}{8} = 0.125$.

questions.q: A trader offers 'buy 19, get 1 free' on a book. Another shop offers a flat 6% discount. Which offer is better for the customer, and by how much (per cent)?
questions.solution: 'Buy 19 get 1 free' $= \frac{1}{20} \times 100 = 5\%$ off. Flat 6% gives 1% more.
questions.shortcut: The scheme's discount is 1/20 of what you RECEIVE, not 1/19.

questions.q: A boat covers 30 km downstream in 2 hours and returns upstream in 3 hours. The speed of the stream is:
A can complete a work in 20 days and B in 15 days. A works alone for 5 days, after which B joins him. In how many days in total is the work completed?
questions.solution:
A alone did $\frac{5}{20} = \frac14$. Remaining $\frac34$ at $\frac{7}{60}$/day → $\frac{45}{7} = 6\frac37$ days.
Total $= 5 + 6\frac37 = 11\frac37$ days.

questions.q:
Select the letter that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

**C, D, F, I, M, ?**
Find the odd one out: **8, 27, 64, 100**
questions.solution: 8 = 2³, 27 = 3³, 64 = 4³ are cubes; 100 lies between 4³ = 64 and 5³ = 125, and is not a cube → **100**.
questions.shortcut: Cube roots to 10 by heart; check the gap between neighbouring cubes.

questions.q: **Rahul is older than Vijay; Sunil is younger than Vijay; Anil is older than Rahul. Who is the youngest?**
questions.solution: Anil > Rahul > Vijay > Sunil → youngest = **Sunil**.
questions.shortcut: 'Younger than' points the arrow the other way; chain and read the tail.

questions.q: Select the related number: **6 : 35 :: 9 : ?**
questions.solution: 35 = 36 − 1 = 6² − 1, so the rule is **square then minus 1**. 9² − 1 = **80**. (81 is the plain-square trap.)
